tags.summary: A news piece lists key funding, launch and legal milestones in Anthropic's valuation rise from 2021 to 2026.
Per Nuvama data, mutual funds bought Rs 42,500 crore and FIIs sold Rs 34,200 crore in Indian equities in October.
Putin says Trump is genuinely committed to resolving conflicts, including Ukraine, after a trilateral meeting with Xi in Shenzhen.
An Anthropic IPO could create thousands of employee millionaires, including junior staff, through stock-based compensation.
Fed official Paulson says understanding, rather than guidance, drives effective central bank communication.
A report says Anthropic's market debut did not lift US stock markets.
California is probing Nvidia over AI chips in China, following the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang.
Japanese cars and beer are gaining ground in South Korea as bilateral relations improve.
A headline says BJP is focusing on 36 prominent leaders in its Punjab 2027 election planning.
An opinion column addresses Nigerian governor Hamzat's campaign promises.
Omar Abdullah says Jammu and Kashmir firms should hire locals and will not tolerate attempts to recruit outsiders.
A Nigerian NDC governorship candidate inaugurated a 310-member campaign council.
Oil prices retreated as traders focused on a hawkish rate outlook, while Hormuz tanker disruptions offset surplus forecasts.
Investigators say the crew of the yacht Bayesian were unaware of risks before it sank off Sicily, killing seven people.
Zee Business promotes its morning show with a market outlook and stock ideas for 20 November 2026.
Market expert Raja Venkatraman shares three stock picks for 20 November with a technical outlook and trade strategy.
Analysts say Nifty may find support at 25,200-25,250 and that Nifty Bank hit a new peak above 63,000, led by PSU banks.
Zee Business live programme page covering early market action and trading strategies, with Anil Singhvi as anchor.
Zee Business 24x7 live channel page promoting market updates and trading strategy shows.
Hormuz oil flows reportedly hit a record and Saudi exports rose 21%, while Brent remains above $92 a barrel.
The dollar is reported to be heading for a fourth weekly gain, linked to an Anthropic IPO and Fed rate hike bets.
Motilal Oswal's Chandan Taparia recommends buying M&M and Bank of Baroda with target prices and stop-losses; Sensex and Nifty hit nine-month highs.
Foreign portfolio investors have made record buying, with financial services making up half of November inflows.
MarketSmith India lists its top stock recommendations for 20 November.
An article asks which three sectors investors should track in 2027.
Median gain across 16 marquee investors' portfolios fell to 4.4% in September quarter from 18.1% in June; Damani holdings lost value.
Motilal Oswal Alternates plans to raise up to ₹3,000 crore for its first office fund targeting Grade A office developments in six cities.
Paytm has received a licence to restart its digital wallet business, which could help it regain payment transactions, though UPI dominance is a hurdle.
Over 70% of 2026 IPOs trade above issue price, amid geopolitical tensions, high crude, a stronger dollar and a weaker rupee.
Sikorski says a Trump-Putin meeting may not end the Ukraine war and could make Putin overestimate his negotiating position.
An article argues that AI and semiconductor manufacturing are increasingly important for India.
An Equitymaster article lists five small-cap stocks said to have large order books and expansion plans.
D2C beauty startups are seeking capital, with brands in the sector reportedly growing 1.5-2x over two years.
Bijnis rebrands as Zorit and raises Rs 27 crore, with participation from Info Edge, WaterBridge and Better Capital.
An article reports that the Tata Sons board is making a trip amid ongoing churn at the group.
Airbnb's new rules on what hosts can ask guests to do come into force, possibly reducing chores but raising costs.
An article discusses what food is acceptable to eat at one's desk during a lunch break.
Tens of thousands of UK fridges were reportedly secured from hackers in a nationwide operation involving supermarkets and other sites.
A market preview lists stocks in the news, brokerage calls and trade setups for the November 20 trading session.
An article profiles two non-pharma stocks with 24%+ sales growth, one of which aims to double revenue by FY30.
Fusion CX acquisitions are said to establish footholds in Australia and Germany.
IPO-bound Aragen plans to spend Rs 150 crore over two years on expansion, according to its MD.
An article asks how the US can limit damage to Nvidia, apparently in the context of US policy on its chips.
Karnataka opposition leader R Ashoka accuses the Congress government of pushing the state toward bankruptcy through taxes and price hikes.
Sources say TSMC is tightening AI chip curbs for China after new US rules close a manufacturing loophole.
Trump says the US spies on China and discussed the Huang affair with Xi, amid a row involving Nvidia.
Greaves Cotton is expanding its marine business overseas and targeting Europe for growth.
Schneider Electric and BCG announce a partnership to accelerate AI-led smart manufacturing in India.
Royal Enfield may enter the classic bike segment and is reportedly planning a 250cc hybrid bike for around FY28.
Fairfax takes control of IIFL Capital after completing an open offer.
A judge rules a legal case against McDonald's over alleged abuse of younger workers can proceed.
Anthropic is reportedly about to sell shares on the US stock market, which would make its founders very rich.
